definitions: To shine with a flickering light; to glimmer.
A sparkle or glimmer of light.
A sparkle of delight in the eyes.

blocks.text: My Heart Twinkle Twinkle is a 2015 South Korean television series starring Jang Shin-young, Bae Soo-bin, Lee Tae-im, and Nam Bo-ra. Cut short from the original order of 50 episodes due to abysmal ratings ranging from 2 to 3 percent, it aired on SBS TV from January 17 to April 12, 2015 on Saturdays and Sundays at 22:00 for 26 episodes.

"Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" is an English lullaby. The lyrics are from an early-19th-century English poem written by Jane Taylor, "The Star". The poem, which is in couplet form, was first published in 1806 in Rhymes for the Nursery, a collection of poems by Taylor and her sister Ann. It is now sung to the tune of the French melody "Ah! vous dirai-je, maman", which was first published in 1761 and later arranged by several composers, including Mozart with Twelve Variations on "Ah vous dirai-je, Maman". The English lyrics have five stanzas, although only the first is widely known.

Twinkle Twinkle is a South Korean television series starring Kim Hyun-joo, Lee Yu-ri, Kim Suk-hoon and Kang Dong-ho. It aired on MBC TV from February 12 to August 14, 2011 on Saturdays and Sundays at 20:40 for 54 episodes.
